leadText:
Oralie (Japanese: オトネ Otone) is a character of the day who appeared in Ya See We Want An Evolution!.

She is the younger sister of Haley and is also a member of the B-Button League. As a member of the league, she aims to make her the strongest Pokémon without having to evolve it.
